title: Lacunary maximal operators on convex boundaries
summary: We disprove the cap-sufficiency proposal in Wright's Problem 16 for $1 3$. For each fixed exponent in these ranges, one smooth strictly convex domain has finite original directional cap integral, while the lacunary maximal operator of complete arclength fails restricted weak type. We also give a geometric sufficient condition for strong $L^p$ boundedness, for every finite $1<p<\infty$, on an arbitrary given bounded convex domain.
